MihawkGen, the frame generator from mihawk-99's PS5_MihawkGen
(https://github.com/mihawk-99/PS5_MihawkGen, commit c57232a), unchanged: its
framegen/include, framegen/src (with the compiled shaders) and the network's
weights (models/network.fgw). GPL-3.0-or-later, see LICENSE.md.

ps5/src/ps5_framegen.cpp puts it behind the renderer's frame generator hook.
